name: Letty Lilly
greetingText: Also known as Leticia when she wants to act serious.
wishText: Happy 22nd, Leticia. May this year bring you real joy, soft money, loud laughter, better selfies, and a man brave enough to finally show face because honestly, we are waiting. From your Ex Crush.
textInChatBox: Happy 22nd birthday, Letty Lilly! You professional troublemaker, secret softie, and certified bad-person accuser. May your day be sweet, your account be less broke, and your mysterious man stop hiding. From your Ex Crush.
text2: I was going to send a normal birthday message.
text3: Then I remembered who you are.
text4: So I had to make something
text5Content: you are annoying, funny, beautiful, and loved
outroText: From your Ex Crush. Okay birthday girl, go enjoy your day and stop pretending you are not smiling.
replayText: Click here to watch it again, or send it to the mysterious man.
